user.title: Set up Smart Home Suite
user.description: Creates the central Smart Home Suite entry and manages its modules.

abort.already_configured: Smart Home Suite is already configured.

init.title: Smart Home Suite modules
init.description: Enable only the modules used by this installation. Client Mode (alpha) hides the selected panels from non-administrator users.

data_description.client_mode_enabled: Administrators keep the full interface. Only non-administrator users are restricted.
data_description.client_hidden_panels: Choose the sidebar panels clients must not see.

module_setup_failed.title: A Smart Home Suite module failed to start
module_setup_failed.description: The {module} module is enabled but could not load. Other modules remain isolated and can continue working. Review Smart Home Suite diagnostics and the Home Assistant logs.

smart_support_provider_unavailable.title: Smart Support requires attention
smart_support_provider_unavailable.description: Smart Support is enabled and has a support user configured, but its account-action provider is not ready. Missing: {actions}. Other Smart Home Suite modules are not affected. If a support session was active, immediately verify the state of that account before continuing. Check Spook and restart Home Assistant if it was just installed.

client_mode_no_client_users.title: Client Mode has no client accounts
client_mode_no_client_users.description: Client Mode is enabled but there is no active non-administrator user, so every account still sees the full interface. Create a regular (non-administrator) user for the customer in Settings → People.
